text: {"label":"Preschool and Early Childhood Development","definition":"Behavioral research and practice in preschool and early childhood settings: teaching life, social, and readiness skills, preventing emerging problem behavior, infant operant learning, and coaching preschool teachers and parents.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on typical and special-needs preschool settings and developmental skill-building, not pediatric clinical treatment, clinic-based early intervention care, or K-12 classroom disruption management."}
